scope: Candidate exact effect serialization for native WitchGameCore implementation and tests. Not a rules approval.

combat_contract.multi_hit_counter_unit: one eligible enemy root action, not each hit

mandatory_contract_tests: poison persists and ticks by authored duration; cap changes by item; >=5-stack bonus only qualifies at impact-time snapshot
ward replaces only the authored seed action; ward expiry/replacement/absorption conservation; reflection only on own ward absorption and cannot recurse
only effective healing (actual HP deficit) creates barrier, with root-heal gate; full/dead targets do not trigger
counter and pressure increment once per eligible root action, not per hit; cap3; hammer consumes snapshot stacks once
cover barrier target, expiry, ICD and recursion cap are deterministic
familiar mark expiry and dash condition; chase once per eligible event subject to 1500ms ICD
equipment rarity upgrades preserve latent affixes and do not change core effect semantics
same combat seed and same equipment snapshot replay byte-identically

candidate_first_challenges.title: 古樹の脈動
candidate_first_challenges.test: root multi-hit + branch heavy; counter capped per root action; compare fortress and poison endurance

candidate_first_challenges.title: 水鏡のゆらぎ
candidate_first_challenges.test: 6s closed / 4s open; closed direct mitigation 50%; poison remains effective; values are test-only

candidate_first_challenges.title: 連槌の検分
candidate_first_challenges.test: separate root-action cadence from multi-hit; compare pressure/counter and ward/heal approaches

reject_conditions: evolved item silently ignored or accepted with base-only semantics
victory is made dependent on direct damage only, a specific paid item, or LR quality
enemy mitigation is raised after seeing build results to force diversity
seed, player-controlled tactic, or future enemy action leaks into automatic policy
